scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ai/core build && pnpm --filter @ai/web build && pnpm --filter @ai/api build
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && node scripts/check-css-colors.mjs && node scripts/check-no-icon-libs.mjs && node scripts/email-tokens.mjs --check
scripts.compliance:capture: node scripts/with-env.mjs REFERENCE_ONLY=1 playwright test -c compliance/playwright.config.ts --project=reference --workers=1
scripts.harness: node scripts/with-env.mjs REFERENCE_ONLY=1 playwright test -c compliance/playwright.config.ts --project=harness
scripts.compliance:docker: docker run --rm --network host -v $PWD:/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v$(node -p "require('@playwright/test/package.json').version")-noble bash -lc 'corepack enable && pnpm i --frozen-lockfile && pnpm "$@"' --
